title: Vantex 16x
description: A Modern Dark Themed UHC PvP Texturepack
body: Vantex 16x is a Minecraft 26.1 dark-themed PvP texturepack mainly designed for the UHC mode but that will accompany you in any other mode just as good. It currently features: - Retextured Diamond Sword and Tools - Retextured Diamond Armor - Retextured Cobwebs - Retextured Cobblestone - Retextured PvP Items like Golden Apples, Bow, Crossbow, Arrows, Buckets - Retextured Enchant Glint - Dark GUI - Dark and Cleaner Particles Enjoy!
